description: Hi, I’m Marwa Yasser, a secondary school student passionate about space and science. Through Enactus, I gained experience in teamwork, research, and project development. I created this team to explore NASA’s data and solve real-world challenges. I’m looking for creative, committed teammates with skills in programming, data analysis, astronomy, research, or design who are eager to learn and collaborate.
summary: Our project is a 3D  Virtual Space Museum that allows visitors to explore the museum and discover real equipment and spacecraft used by NASA in Moon and Mars exploration missions. The museum features 3D models and images of these artifacts, along with interactive videos that tell their stories, explain their missions, and highlight their scientific importance. It also offers an engaging educational experience through interactive questions and quizzes, rewarding visitors for correct answers to encourage learning and help them discover more about the history of space exploration.
details:
Beyond the Dust is an educational space exploration project that brings the fascinating history of space missions closer to people through cinematic documentary videos.

Our project presents NASA missions, spacecraft, and robotic explorers, explaining their designs, scientific objectives, journeys, challenges, and remarkable achievements. Through engaging storytelling and realistic visual scenes, we transform complex scientific information into an accessible and exciting experience.

The project targets students, young learners, space enthusiasts, and anyone interested in astronomy and space exploration.

We used scientific research, scriptwriting, AI-assisted video generation, and digital editing tools to develop our content. What makes our project creative is the combination of scientific accuracy and immersive storytelling, allowing viewers to experience the exploration journey rather than simply read about it.

Our main goal is to inspire curiosity, promote scientific awareness, and encourage the next generation to explore the universe.
